abstract: Digital product design services take a new software product from idea to launch through product strategy, user experience (UX) research, user interface (UI) design and prototype validation. Our digital product design engagement takes 8–16 weeks, costs $60,000–$180,000, and ends with a tested, development-ready product design in Figma.

sections.answer: Digital product design is the end-to-end process of defining, designing and validating a software product, from the first problem statement to the launch-ready user interface. One team covers product strategy, user research, information architecture (IA), interaction design, visual design and usability validation.
sections.body: Digital product design starts with evidence: UX research services supply the user needs, and design turns the user needs into screens. Our product design process follows the Double Diamond model, with 2 discovery phases and 2 delivery phases.

sections.h2: What does digital product design include?
sections.answer: Our digital product design services include 6 deliverables: a product strategy, a user research report, an information architecture, a clickable prototype, a UI design and a developer handoff package.

items.title: Product strategy.
items.body: A 1-page product brief defines target users, Jobs to be Done and success metrics, for example weekly active users and task completion time.

items.title: User research report.
items.body: Interviews with 5–8 users per user group produce findings, for example unmet needs, current workarounds and switching triggers.

items.title: Information architecture.
items.body: A sitemap and user-flow diagrams define every screen, for example sign-up, onboarding, the core workflow and settings.

items.title: Clickable prototype.
items.body: A Figma prototype covers the core user flows, for example the first-run experience and the main task.

items.title: UI design.
items.body: High-fidelity screens follow platform guidelines, for example Material Design 3 on Android and the Apple Human Interface Guidelines (HIG) on iOS.

items.title: Developer handoff package.
items.body: Annotated Figma files, design tokens and component specifications go to engineering, for example spacing, states and breakpoints.

sections.h2: How does the digital product design process work?
sections.answer: The digital product design process takes 8–16 weeks (40–80 working days) and runs in 5 steps, from discovery to developer handoff.

items.title: Discovery and product strategy (5–10 days)
items.body: We run stakeholder workshops, map the Jobs to be Done and set success metrics with the Google HEART framework.

items.title: User research (5–15 days)
items.body: Researchers interview 5–8 users per user group and synthesize the findings in Dovetail.

items.title: Information architecture and flows (5–10 days)
items.body: Designers build the sitemap and user-flow diagrams for every core task.

items.title: Prototype and validation (10–20 days)
items.body: 5 users per round complete tasks in the clickable prototype on Maze, and each round ends with a System Usability Scale (SUS) score.

items.title: UI design and handoff (15–25 days)
items.body: Designers produce screens that meet Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 level AA, hand the Figma files to engineering and stay with the engineers through launch.

sections.h2: What are the benefits of digital product design?
sections.answer: Digital product design has 4 benefits: it increases activation rate, improves the user experience, reduces rework cost and develops a validated product roadmap.

items.title: Increases activation rate
items.body: Onboarding flows tested with real users before development increase the share of new sign-ups who complete the first key task.

items.title: Improves the user experience
items.body: One team designs strategy, flows and UI together, which improves consistency across every screen and platform.

items.title: Reduces rework cost
items.body: Usability issues found in a clickable prototype cost hours to fix, while the same usability issues found after launch cost development sprints.

items.title: Develops a validated product roadmap
items.body: Each validation round develops the product roadmap with evidence, for example which features users need at launch and which features wait.

sections.h2: Digital product design vs web app design
sections.answer: Digital product design covers a new product end to end, from strategy to launch; web app design redesigns or extends the workflows of an existing logged-in application. Teams with no product yet start with digital product design.

sections.h2: How much does digital product design cost?
sections.answer: Digital product design costs $60,000–$180,000 and takes 8–16 weeks. The price depends on 4 factors: the number of platforms, the number of user groups, the number of core user flows and the number of validation rounds.
sections.body: A single-platform web product with 1 user group, 4–5 core flows and 1 validation round sits near $60,000. A web and mobile product with 3 user groups, 10–12 core flows, 3 validation rounds and a starter component library sits near $180,000. Teams that need a full component library with governance add design system services.

sections.h2: When should a founder hire digital product design services?
sections.answer: A founder should hire digital product design services in 5 situations:
items: A new software product needs a design, if the company has no in-house product designers.
A startup funds version 1 of a product, if the launch date sits 3–6 months away.
An internal tool becomes a customer-facing product, if external users need a new onboarding flow.
A product concept needs validation, if engineering has not started building.
A legacy product needs a full rebuild, if incremental fixes no longer solve core usability issues.

sections.answer: These answers cover the 5 questions buyers ask most about digital product design services.

faqs.q: Does digital product design include user research?
faqs.a: Yes. Every digital product design engagement includes 5–8 user interviews per user group and at least 1 usability validation round.

faqs.q: Do digital product designers write code?
faqs.a: No. Digital product designers deliver Figma files, design tokens and component specifications, and the client's engineers write the code.

faqs.q: Can digital product design start from a rough idea?
faqs.a: Yes. Digital product design starts from a problem statement, and the discovery step turns the rough idea into a product brief with target users and success metrics.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a product design agency and a freelancer?
faqs.a: A product design agency staffs strategy, research, UX and UI designers on one team, while a freelancer covers 1–2 of those disciplines.

faqs.q: How long does digital product design take?
faqs.a: Digital product design takes 8–16 weeks, which equals 40–80 working days, from discovery to developer handoff.
